title: Optimal star-discrepancy order in dimension at least three

items.title: Optimal star-discrepancy order for fixed dimension at least three
items.statement: For each fixed integer d≥3, determine the exact asymptotic order of δ_d(n):=inf{D_n^*(P): P∈([0,1)^d)^n}, using the half-open anchored-box star discrepancy with repetitions counted. Is the conjectured order δ_d(n) asymp_d n^-1(log n)^(d-1) correct?

title: Optimal star-discrepancy order in dimension at least three — Examples

items.title: Exact star discrepancy of the center point
items.statement: For P=(1/2,…,1/2) in [0,1)^d and each integer d≥2, D_1^*(P)=1−2^-d; in particular the values are 3/4 in dimension two and 7/8 in dimension three.
